sections.body: Fruit and vegetables help our bodies grow strong and stay well. 🥦🍎
Eat the rainbow! Red tomatoes, orange carrots, green peas, purple grapes. 🌈
How many colours of fruit and vegetables can you eat today?
Offer new vegetables many times without pressure. Children often need to try a food 10+ times before they like it.

hints: Vegetables grow in the ground or on plants.
Peas and broccoli are vegetables. Which one here grows in the ground?

options: Eat fruit and veg of many colours 🌈
hints: A rainbow has lots of colours.
Fruit and vegetables come in many colours.
Red tomatoes, green peas, orange carrots… that's a rainbow on your plate!
quiz.explain: It means eating fruit and vegetables of many colours. 🌈
